description: Days with wind gusts greater than gale force (1975–13) is a dataset listed in Ministry for the Environment Data Service (data.mfe.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Reporting - Public. Strong wind events can cause significant damage, for example, to trees and buildings. They can occur with frontal weather systems and around strong convection events, such as thunderstorms. Global climate change may change the frequency of damaging wind events in almost all areas in New Zealand in winter and decrease the frequency in summer. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Reporting - Public. It offers 1 resource(s) in table. The portal shows 2015-10-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 New Zealand. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-mfe-portal.
